source.name: Tesla's February 2020 raise was a single underwritten primary offering -- no separate rights offering occurred, so no shares were issued through a rights mechanism
source.notes: Left at the template default of 25 (placeholder rights-shares-issued) before this fix. The 'Rights Offering' sheet's own C6 ('Rights shares offered') reads 'Cap Table & Dilution'!C8, not C7 -- so despite C7 already correctly holding the real 2.65mm primary share count, the Rights Offering sheet's downstream computation (C16-C19) was pulling 25mm phantom rights shares, producing an 'Expected net rights proceeds' of ~$19.175bn on the Decision & Checks dashboard (row 23) for a transaction that raised about $2bn total. Setting this to 0 correctly reflects that no rights offering happened, without touching the already-correct C7/C11-driven primary-offering figures (Cap Table 'Gross/Net primary proceeds', matching the case's recorded forecast/realized).
